title: Chapter 439
paragraphs: Chapter 439
Episode 126. Someday, when you forget, like an unannounced disaster (2)
The sharp and rattling voice seemed to tear through the dark night sky.
The energy in the voice caused the raindrops to scatter in a circle, unable to touch the exile.
Knight Rosa Runcandel, come out and listen to our story...
It was a voice that anyone living in the Garden of Swords would have doubted their ears.
Neither an enforcement knight nor a black knight could call Rosa like that.
It felt like a dream. For the relatives and guardians passing by him, it was an incomprehensible scene if it wasn't a dream.
'The weather was strange and cloudy... was this a sign that such a thing would happen?'
'I felt uneasy seeing him standing still in front of the main house!'
Swoosh!
The guardians who drew their swords were confused. Judging by the strong and heavy energy, he was undoubtedly an enforcement knight, but they had no idea why he was doing such a thing.
They knew they were no match for him. However, they just had to hold on until the other enforcement knights or riders waiting inside came out.
The exile easily fended off the swords of the guardian knights rushing towards him from both sides.
With a single blow, the guardians were knocked back and tumbled on the wet grass, and the exile shouted again.
"You must remember my voice, Rosa Runcandel. Show yourself!"
There were riders looking down at him from various parts of the main house.
"Wow... I thought my ears were wrong?"
"I've never seen a crazy person like that. What on earth is going on?"
Myu and Anne, who were in the library, nearly dropped their teacups. Ran and Vigo, who were sitting in front of them, were the same.
"...Judging by his skills, he's a real enforcement knight."
"Old-style armor, a person expelled from the family long ago?"
As Ran and Vigo spoke, Myu's neck flushed with anger.
"Damn it! What has happened to the family's discipline? The youngest keeps causing trouble, and now even the lower ranks are in chaos. Right, older brothers?"
Diphus and Mary were also looking down at the exile from another room. They were speechless for a while and couldn't say anything.
"...Huh, what's going on? Older brother, do you have any idea?"
"No. But somehow... he seems to be someone related to the youngest."
"The youngest? Judging by the armor, he was an enforcement knight before the youngest was born. Is that possible?"
"It's just an intuition."

"True, it's the youngest's way. Turning the family upside down like this. Hmm... let's go down for now. Before being killed, we need to hear why a person of enforcement knight level did this. And see if he's really related to the youngest."
The exile continued to push back the guardian knights who were attacking with the other patrollers.
The awe-inspiring presence of the knight called the "One-Man Army" of the 9-star order stood out, but this place was the Garden of Swords.
It was impossible for him to continue facing so many guardians alone, and high-ranking knights who recognized the emergency situation were gradually revealing themselves.
Knights in gray armor similar to that of the banished one began to appear throughout the garden. They were the family's executioner knights.
Despite the sudden and unprecedented situation, they showed no sign of confusion.

They didn't care why the banished one was doing this, or to which group of executioner knights he belonged. They were simply focused on subduing him as quickly as possible so that the family's leaders could make a decision in peace.
The banished one roared, causing the nearby guardians to step back.
That was his last-ditch effort. Blades from nearly a dozen executioner knights entered the fray between the guardians, and there was no more room for him to hold on.
He managed to fend off the first few blades. However, the executioner knights who were on par with him or had the upper hand soon pierced through his sword and armor.
Like a dizzying whirlwind, the shining blades tore through the banished one's old gray armor.
His arm armor was pierced, his chest armor sliced, his waist armor crumbled, and his leg armor burst.
Blood and muddy water splashed around, but the fierce rain didn't allow his blood to leave a red trace.
The banished one coughed up blood between his helmet.
Eventually, the executioner knights forced the banished one to kneel in the middle of the courtyard.

With each thrust, the executioner knights pinned the banished one's thighs to the ground with their swords, preventing him from causing any more chaos. They also stepped on his back, forcing him to bow down.
He looked like a young hunter who had captured and displayed an old, fierce beast.
The banished one didn't scream once as the swords pierced through his thighs and knees and stuck to the ground.
It was the same when his arms were broken by the executioner knights' stomping.
The subjugation was complete. Now, all that remained was the judgment of the decision-maker.
All the knights, except for Luna who had gone to the Black Sea and Luntia who was on a mission on the continent, were making their way to the courtyard.
As Joshua approached, the executioner knights attempted to remove the banished one's helmet so he could see the face clearly.
However, at that moment, Mary shouted, "Stop! Grant him the mercy of removing his helmet himself."
Mary believed that regardless of the reason for the banished one's rebellion, it was right to preserve the honor of allowing him to remove his helmet himself.
The executioner knights obeyed Mary's command only after Joshua nodded his head.
It took quite a long time for the banished one to remove his helmet with his trembling, broken arms, and in the meantime, the knights and important figures of the family gathered around him.

The elders, including Jordan, arrived in their steel carriages at the courtyard, revealing the face of the exiled knight as he removed his helmet—a crumpled and distorted face of a former execution knight.
Jordan, who had just arrived, was so suffocated with anxiety that he felt like he would go mad. The moment he began to spout nonsense, there would undoubtedly be issues with his position.
However, he couldn't immediately demand the man's death. Jordan had no choice but to suppress his anxiety and watch the situation quietly.
"State your name."
Joshua and the exile's eyes met.
Instead of telling Joshua his name, the exile raised his voice again.
"Rosa Runcandel! You're not coming out until the end. But you must be listening to my words."
"I said, state your name."
"I have no name to reveal to you, 2nd Knight. We were defeated and trampled by Rosa without even a chance to become your knights. If you're curious about my name, ask your mother."
Joshua's eyes widened.
He had no idea that the old execution knights had been subjugated by Rosa because of him.
"What are you talking about?"
"Ha, what am I talking about? Do you really know nothing? I can't help but laugh."
"Speak in a way that I can understand."

"My comrades and I used to serve the family head and the 1st Knight. But we couldn't serve you, the 2nd Knight. Rosa Runcandel decided that we were not suitable swords for you. She determined that you couldn't control us like the 1st Knight did."
Comparisons with Luna always evoked a sense of inferiority deep within Joshua.
However, Joshua didn't seem to be shaken by those words.
"So, you rebelled because you felt wronged by that?"
"Rebel? I am simply revealing the truth. There are others who committed rebellion. It's strange, isn't it, 2nd Knight? Despite being personally purged by the Black Panther, I managed to stay alive."
The exile struggled to turn his head and looked for Jordan and the elders. Upon meeting Jordan's gaze, Jordan was seized by the urge to cut him down but managed to hide it.
"Black Sword Chairman, Jordan Runcandel. That man spared me and some of my comrades, without your mother knowing."
At those words, the knights shifted their gaze to Jordan.
Among the knights, only Joshua looked at Jin instead of Jordan.
'It's your doing...'
'Your Runcandel is filled with lies and betrayals, Joshua.'
As their thoughts crossed, Jordan finally let his anger burst.
"How dare you babble such nonsense, you filthy traitor! I saved you? I was the one who checked the supplies of you and your comrades until the end, following the acting family head's orders."
"So you created fake supplies to save us. You're quite the actor, Black Sword Chairman."
"Moreover, you guys were purged not because the 2nd Knight was lacking, but because you committed treasonous acts. Now that you're about to die, are you trying to make up a false sense of honor?"
"False? I came to the Sword Garden on my own accord, to face my death. Nothing else could be the reason if it's not the truth."
At that desperate outcry, just as Jordan was about to reply—
"There's no proof anywhere that you're not a traitor, just as the Black Sword Chairman said."
Joshua spoke.
"Everything the acting family head does is for the family. A few words from a filthy traitor cannot taint the faith that all of Runcandel have. Your plan has failed."
That was also meant for Jin.
Swish, the black blade of the Black Sword Kainer was drawn from its sheath.
"Speak your last words if you have any. I'll listen."
"Someday."
The exiled knight who started his last testament was looking at Jin.
"When you've forgotten, like an unforeseen disaster."
The exile smiled faintly with his torn mouth, and Jin decided to forget that he had tried to kill his comrades.
"A bound soul will appear and reveal your filthy nature to the world."
Squeak-!
'Thank you, 12th Knight.'
The moment his neck was cut by the Black Sword Kainer, the exile thought.
That the last remaining exile, Lutan Ferman, would someday return to this land through the 12th Knight, the day when the spirits of the unjustly killed execution knights would return.
Thud...
The exile's head fell to the ground.
"Leave the corpse for the dogs to eat."
As Joshua said that and turned around, the people gathered in the courtyard began to disperse.
Those who witnessed the exile's end could not help but wonder one thing.
Was he really a traitor?
Amidst betrayal, doubt, and death, Jin stood tall and held his place until everyone had left the courtyard.
Then, he took out a single rose he had prepared in his pocket and placed it on the exile's chest, and retrieved the exile's broken sword.
To someday plant it in the Sword Garden.
